correctness.rationale: A direct marking argument proves conditional independent uniform compositions, and a nested-cut coupling proves all-threshold monotonicity for each color. The total covariance identity yields positive association. Counting ordered disjoint cyclic 01 transitions proves the factorial moment identity, with exact small-size conventions. The standalone exhaustive checker independently verifies 66 composition profiles for n<=14 including conditional independence, exact covariance, every singleton threshold comparison, and all cross-color cumulative short-run coordinate pairs; no finite check is treated as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The claimed all-threshold cross-color isotone association in fixed-content cyclic words is not stated in the relevant inspected primary results. In particular, Eryilmaz (2008) has a broader joint enumerator for linear multi-color run statistics; that prior coverage is explicitly acknowledged, and the distinct evaluated theorem requires a refinement coupling and gives strict stochastic signs. Targeted scholarly searches did not identify an equal or stronger isotone association statement. Priority remains qualified pending independent review.

value.rationale: The result gives simultaneous cross-color dependence signs for every increasing statistic of a complete multithreshold short-run profile, relevant to two-class clustering and runs diagnostics. It identifies a one-dimensional source of dependence (the common count of runs), supplies an exact strictly positive singleton covariance, and characterizes the degenerate one-color-count boundary. This is a structural stochastic-order consequence and not merely a table entry or restatement of a marginal distribution.
